[[File:Medivh's Chambers.png|thumb|300px|Medivh's Chambers.]]
'''Medivh's Chambers''', located near the summit of the [[Tower of Karazhan]], are the private bedchambers and study of [[Medivh]], the last [[Guardian of Tirisfal]]. The room contains a worktable, an elevated bed, and many paintings and statues.
